entry.title: Firefox 160.0/162.0a1 is available on CSD3!
entry.content:
See https://cambridge-ceu.github.io/csd3/applications/firefox.html

we have from module avail ceuadmin/firefox:

Date Module 1 Module 2 Module 3 Module 4 Module 5
10/11/2026 firefox/60.5.1-1.el7 firefox/153.0esr firefox/160.0 firefox/162.0a1 firefox/nightly
28/10/2026 firefox/60.5.1-1.el7 firefox/153.0esr firefox/159.0 firefox/161.0a1 firefox/nightly
22/10/2026 firefox/60.5.1-1.el7 firefox/153.0esr firefox/158.0 firefox/161.0a1 firefox/nightly

23/7/2026 firefox/60.5.1-1.el7 firefox/153.0esr firefox/155.0a1   firefox/nightly
20/6/2026 firefox/60.5.1-1.el7 firefox/152.0 firefox/154.0a1   firefox/nightly
24/5/2026 firefox/60.5.1-1.el7 firefox/151.0.1 firefox/152.0a1   firefox/nightly
27/4/2026 firefox/60.5.1-1.el7 firefox/150.0 firefox/152.0a1   firefox/nightly
24/4/2026 firefox/60.5.1-1.el7 firefox/150.0 firefox/151.0a1   firefox/nightly
26/3/2026 firefox/60.5.1-1.el7 firefox/149.0 firefox/151.0a1   firefox/nightly
20/1/2026 firefox/60.5.1-1.el7 firefox/147.0.1 firefox/148.0a1   firefox/nightly
29/9/2025 firefox/60.5.1-1.el7 firefox/143.0.1 firefox/143.0a1 firefox/145.0a1 firefox/nightly

such that

  • 60.5.1-1.el7 is actually a singularity module.
  • 143.0.1 is the first official release at ceuadmin.
  • 145.0a1 is officially nightly.
  • ceuadmin/firefox/nightly is still a symbolic link to 143.0a1.

The general context is described here, https://cambridge-ceu.github.io/csd3/systems/web.html.

A real-world usage on CSD3 is shown here, https://jinghuazhao.github.io/Caprion/.
